notes: v675 - grading stops uploading the market. Until now, the first time each day the report card was graded, the app uploaded every share's price history to the server - tens of megabytes, often from a phone - for data the server's own pantry already holds 99% complete back to 2023. The app now asks the server to grade from its OWN store first (a request of a few hundred bytes), and the whole fleet shares one cached answer per day. The upload path remains as the fallback and still covers the 'Any' liquidity floor, older servers, and days the pantry has not ingested yet - every refusal names its reason and the app quietly falls back.
